author: Denise Neil
title: A 2026 list of Wichita restaurants offering Mother's Day brunches, freebies - NewsBreak
text:
By Denise Neil ,
8 hours ago Mother’s Day is one of the biggest brunch days of the year, and lots of Wichita restaurants will be offering buffets or specials. jenifoto/Getty Images/iStockphoto Mother’s Day is the biggest brunch day of the year for most Wichita restaurants, so the list of places offering special brunch buffets and deals for moms is always long.
The big day is Sunday, and several owners say their reservation books are nearly full. Here’s a guide to many of the restaurants offering buffets, free meals and more. If you know of one that’s missing, email dneil@wichitaeagle.com
Brunch buffets 2026 54 Craft & Co. , 549 S. Rock Road, 316-687-6455: The restaurant in the Holiday Inn Wichita East is offering a brunch buffet from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. that’s $28 for adults, $18 for children ages 3-9, free for ages 2 and under. Moms get a free drink or dessert. Call for reservations.
6S Steakhouse , 6200 W. 21st St., 316-361-6667: Offering a Mother’s Day brunch buffet from 10:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. that’s $50 for adults and $30 for children. (The restaurant will reopen for dinner from 5 to 8 p.m.) Call for reservations or visit opentable.com
Chicken N Pickle , 1240 N. Greenwich, 316-535-7150: Brunch buffet runs from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. and is $36 for adults, $6 for children, free for ages 4 and under. Moms get a free blackberry mimosa, a free flower and a $15 off card for a future visit.
Chisholm’s American Beef & Ale House , inside the DoubleTree by Hilton, 2098 S. Airport Road, 316-945-1966: Buffet served from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. It’s $46 for adults, $18 for children. Reservations available at opentable.com
Doo-Dah Diner , 206 E. Kellogg, 316-265-7011: Offering a brunch buffet from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m. that includes smoked prime rib, crab cakes eggs benedict and bananas foster waffles. It’s $45 for adults, $18 for ages 6-10, free for 5 and under. Call for reservations.
Eat at the Wichita Art Museum , 1400 W. Museum Blvd., 316-268-4921: Brunch buffet served from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. It’s $42 for adults, $18 for children 4-12.
Grace Hill Winery , 6310 S. Grace Hill Road, Whitewater: This winery, which is about 30 miles out of Wichita, is offering a Mother’s Day brunch buffet from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. that’s $50 a person and includes a glass of wine. Tickets are available at gracehillwinery.square.site
Itzcali Tapas and Tequila , 2819 E. Central, 316-358-9955: Open for brunch buffet from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. It’s $35 for adults, $15 for children ages 4-12, free for ages 3 and under. Call for reservations.
Mother’s Day is a big brunch holiday, and Larkspur is one of the restaurants offering a buffet. Special to The Eagle Larkspur , 904 E. Douglas, 316-262-5275: Mother’s Day buffet is $45 for adults, $20 for children ages 6-12, and free for 5 and under. Seatings available at 10 a.m., 11:30 a.m., 1 p.m. and 2:30 p.m. Call for reservations.
La Vela Event Venue , 6147 E. 13th St., 316-684-7281: The Candle Club’s event venue will offer a brunch buffet that’s open to the public. It’s from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. and is $40 for adults, $20 for ages 10 and under. Call for reservations.
Magnolia Cafe , 2424 N. Woodlawn, 316-260-1356: Brunch buffet is served 9 a.m.- 2 p.m. and is $32.99 for adults and $12.99 for ages 4-10. Call for reservations.
Napoli Italian Eatery , 7718 E. 37th St. North, 316-260-5859: Mother’s Day brunch buffet is $32.99 for adults, $15.99 for children 4-12. Seatings are at 10 a.m., 10:30, 11:30 a.m., noon, 1 p.m. and 1:30 p.m. Call for reservations.
Newport Grill , 1900 N. Rock Road, 316-636-9555: Brunch buffet will be served from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. and is $50 for adults, $20 for children 5-12 and free for children 4 and under. Call for reservations.
Sedgwick County Zoo , 5555 W. Zoo Blvd, 316-660-9453: The zoo’s restaurant is putting on an all-you-can-eat brunch buffet from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. It’s $25.99 a person and includes one coffee, tea or fountain drink. Moms are admitted to the zoo for free on Mother’s Day weekend. Get tickets at tickets.scz.org
Siena Steakhouse , inside the Ambassador Hotel, 104 S. Broadway, 316-440-5300: Serving a brunch buffet from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. that is $59 for adults, $25 for children. Tickets are available at opentable.com
Spear’s Restaurant & Pie Shop , 4323 W. Maple, 316-943-2783: Brunch buffet served from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
Stearman Field Bar & Grill , 14789 SW 30th St., Benton: Offering a breakfast buffet from 8 a.m. to noon that’s $17.99 for adults and $10.99 for children ages 2-12.
The Sweet Spot , 7703 E. Douglas: Brunch buffet served from 10 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. is $39.99 for adults. The dinner menu will be served from 4 to 8 p.m. Make reservations at opentable.com
Tanya’s Soup Kitchen , 1725 E. Douglas, 316-267-7687: Brunch buffet will be served from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. It’s $32 for adults, $15 for ages 6-12 and free for 5 and under. Bottomless mimosas are $15 extra. Call for reservations, which are required.
Twelve , 12111 W. Maple, 316-440-2812: Serving a brunch buffet from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. that’s $48 for adults. Call for reservations.
Two Brothers BBQ & Sports Grill , 6730 W. Central, 316-440-4077: Barbecue and breakfast brunch buffet served 10 a.m.-2 p.m. is $26.50 for adults, $24.50 for seniors and $16.99 for the breakfast bar alone. Price for ages 3 to 11 is $1.75 multiplied by their age. Kids 2 and under eat free.
Vora , 3252 E. Douglas, 316-977-9277: Brunch buffet served from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. includes a prime rib carving station and omelets to order. It’s $42 for adults and $18 for children ages 4-11. (The regular dinner menu will be served from 4 to 9 p.m.) Make brunch reservations by calling or at vorawichita.com
Wine Dive , 4714 E. Douglas, 316-613-2772: Brunch buffet runs from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. and includes a free mimosa for all moms. It’s $41 for adults, $18 for children ages 4-11. Regular dinner service runs from 4 to 9 p.m. Make reservations by calling or at winediveks.com
YaYa’s Eurobistro , 8115 E. 21st St., 316-634-1000: A very limited number of reservations remain for this brunch, so call right away. It’s $45 for adults, $20 for children 6-12 and free for children 5 and under.
Plated brunches, family style AVI , 135 N. Waco, 316-262-3300: Offering family-style meals from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. that will include beef prime rib, smoked ham, creamed potatoes, sauteed green beans, grilled basil cream corn, salad, rolls, carrot cake and chocolate cake. Price is $29 for adults, $12 for ages 9 and under. Kids will get homemade chicken tenders, mac and cheese, and fries. Call for reservations or email info@aviwichita.com
Bar Louie , 316-361-8266: 1523 S. Ridge Road: Serving plated brunch from 10:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. Call for reservations.
The Belmont , 3555 E. Douglas. 316-477-3555: Serving plated brunch menu. Specials available.
Bramble Cafe at Elderslie Farm , 3501 E. 101st St. North, Kechi, 316-226-8862: The Bramble Cafe will be first-come, first-served from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
Bella Vita Bistro , 9506 W. Central, 316-941-4500: The restaurant’s original Chef Adrian is back in town for the weekend and has designed a plated brunch menu that will be served from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. Call for reservations.
Chester’s Chophouse , 1550 N. Webb Road, 316-201-1300: This restaurant will open for Mother’s Day dinner and will offer a special menu. Hours are 4:30 to 9 p.m. Reservations recommended on OpenTable or by phone.
FioRito Ristorante , 3134 E Douglas, 316-364-4707: Open for brunch from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. and offering specials like herb crepes with smoked chicken, and cheese and mortadella strada. Call for reservations.
Larcher’s Market , 3555 E. Douglas, 316-682-5575: Serving brunch from 7 a.m. to 3 p.m. Mother’s Day gift items will be for sale in the market’s “to-go” area as well.
Public at the Brickyard , 129 N. Rock Island: Serving Mother’s Day lunch from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. and offering several brunch specials. William Flynn Jazz Duo will provide live music.
Scotch & Sirloin , 5325 E. Kellogg, 316-685-8701: Offering a plated Mother’s Day menu from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. that’s $65 a person and includes choice of shareable appetizer, choice of salad and choice of entree, with offerings like filet mignon, prime rib and Scottish salmon. Drink specials also will be available
Mother’s Day freebies, to-go option 7 Brew , many Wichita locations: Buy two medium or large drinks and get a free 7 Brewzie insulated sleeve on Sunday.
Meddys , five Wichita locations: Moms eat free at all Meddy’s locations from 5 to 9 p.m. on Sunday.
Sickie’s Garage , 2424 N. Maize Road: Moms eat free with the purchase of an entree of equal or greater values on Mother’s Day, and the first 200 mothers through the door will get a special gift while supplies last.
Olive Tree Catering , 1530 S. Webb Road: 316-636-1100: Offering Mother’s Day brunch items to go that can be picked up from 10:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Sunday. A Family brunch is $135, and a la carte items also are available. Orders must be placed at latour.revelup.online or at 316-636-1100 by noon Friday.
